status: v1.3.2 sulfur-class extension of the v1.3.1 / model 2.0.0 final-writer design
principles: classification is downstream of candidate preservation
raw NIST candidates, ranks and scores are never deleted or changed
exact-name or CAS invariants are applied after all optional evidence layers
AI/model review may select a candidate but cannot override a locked final classification
source labels are operational marker groups, not confirmed source apportionment
sulfur-containing products are reported separately as S instead of being merged into the protein/microbial P class
formula-only N+S candidates are retained in S for sulfur accounting while mixed N/S ambiguity is preserved in warning fields
S is an operational compositional/process-associated class and does not by itself prove anoxia, sulfate reduction, or in-situ sulfurization
thiophene interpretation is explicitly cautioned because elemental sulfur can generate alkylthiophenes during pyrolysis

priority_rules.match: Toluene, toluene, Methylbenzene, Benzene, methyl-, or CAS 108-88-3/108883
priority_rules.warning: Operational group only: toluene is multi-origin and may also arise from charred material, proteins, petrogenic inputs, or secondary pyrolysis; it is not a unique lignin or fulvic-acid tracer.

priority_rules.match: thiophene/alkylthiophene, benzothiophene, dibenzothiophene, thiol/mercaptan, sulfide/disulfide/polysulfide, thiazole/benzothiazole, isothiocyanate/thiocyanate, sulfoxide/sulfone families
priority_rules.paper_class_9: preserved from structural layer (commonly Others or N-containing aromatics)
priority_rules.warning: Operational sulfur class only. Presence is not proof of a unique precursor or redox pathway; alkylthiophenes can form during pyrolysis in the presence of elemental sulfur.

application_specific_note.Lake_Biwa_Figure_4: The Lake Biwa double-shot experiment used toluene as the solvent of the added internal-standard solution; it must not be interpreted as an environmental source marker. Figure 4 is an archived structural-product aggregate. The origin-category correction P to L leaves the structural product class 'Aromatic hydrocarbons' unchanged. Component-level rows underlying the archived aggregate are not deposited, so the figure is not numerically reconstructed from a different data version.

sulfur_class.label: Sulfur-containing / sulfurization-associated
sulfur_class.purpose: separate accounting of sulfur-bearing pyrolysis products, especially useful in anoxic/sulfidic sediments and sludge
sulfur_class.formula_fallback: any S-bearing candidate not caught by a higher-priority contaminant invariant is assigned S at low confidence; N+S is flagged mixed N/S
sulfur_class.interpretive_limit: S is not a direct redox diagnosis. Use with porewater sulfide/sulfate, Fe speciation, total/organic S, and sample context where available.
